rows.en: (Sheryl's concert is coming up soon!)

What's up with you, \p?
You're grinning like an idiot. Get a grip.

Nah, I was just thinking Sheryl's concert
is coming up soon...

Yeah, true. But we'll be there as staff, right?
I doubt we'll get to enjoy it much.
rows.notes: x2, Alto, both genders; the students work the concert.

rows.en:
But that means we get closer than the audience,
right?
Well, sure, but... I'm not interested.
...Figures...
Well, let's both try not to screw up!
(Alto really isn't interested, huh...)
(Sheryl's concert is coming up soon!)
rows.notes: Female; she says Sheryl without -san here, as in the Japanese.

rows.en:
Oh, I was just thinking Sheryl's concert
is coming up soon...

But that means we get closer than the audience,
don't we?
...Yeah, I figured~...
(Saotome-kun really isn't interested, huh...)
(Looks like they've found a new planet.)
\p, what's with that look?

Nah, I was just thinking... they've found
our new planet...

Yeah... A new planet, huh...
It doesn't feel real yet...

We've lived on Frontier our whole lives, after all.
Still... I'm looking forward to our new planet.

Which means... we've got a lot of work
to do, huh...
(He's excited, but I bet he's anxious too.)
rows.notes: Male; 'kitto' reads as a guess about Alto's feelings after his hesitant line.

rows.en: (Looks like they've found a new planet...)

Oh, I was just thinking... they've found
our new planet...
(He's excited, but I bet he's anxious too.)
(I woke up really early for some reason...)

Hey, \p.
What's up? What are you doing out at this hour?
Huh? Alto?

Yeah, I came out for a breath of morning air...
Even inside a ship, the air's cleaner
in the morning.
rows.notes: x2, Alto, both genders; kan = ship (Frontier fleet).

rows.en: I see. Yeah, that makes sense.

Yeah. If I could fly at this hour, it might feel
a little better than usual.
Yeah, you might be right.

(Who'd have thought I'd run into Alto
this early in the morning?)
(I woke up really early for some reason...)
Huh? Saotome-kun?
I see. Yeah, that makes sense.
Yeah, you might be right.

(Who'd have thought I'd run into Saotome-kun
this early in the morning?)

(The last battle did this much damage
to the city...)
Dammit, I never thought it'd come to this...

We should have... I should have
protected this place...
rows.notes: x2, Alto, both genders; object (the city) restored as 'this place'.

rows.en: Don't beat yourself up like that...

I won't let them do any more...
I won't let them!
rows.notes: x2, Alto, both genders; 'them' = the attackers, unnamed in the Japanese.

rows.en: ...Yeah.
(I have to protect the city... and everyone...)
Don't beat yourself up like that...
...Yeah, you're right.
(Phew, I somehow made it through the tests...)

\p.
What's wrong? Why are you so wiped out?

The tests are finally over,
so I'm running on empty...

Geez, if you're like this already,
I worry about you.
rows.notes: x2, Alto, both genders; 'saki ga omoiyarareru'.

rows.en: So how about you, Alto? How'd your tests go?
Hm, well, average. Not bad, I think...
That's what a confident guy would say...

(Alto talks like that, but his grades are
actually pretty good.)
(Phew, I somehow made it through the tests...)

Yeah, the tests are finally over,
so I'm running on empty...

So how about you, Saotome-kun?
How'd your tests go?
Aah, that's what a confident person would say...

(Saotome-kun talks like that, but his grades
are actually pretty good.)

(Whoa, I went to the wrong classroom!
I've gotta hurry!)
rows.notes: Male; nml_alt_007, changing rooms between classes.

rows.en: Agh!
rows.notes: x2, Alto, both genders; follows the player's 'Whoa!' (c01769) on the collision.

rows.en: S-sorry, Alto.

No, I wasn't watching where I was going either.
Sorry.
Looks like you're... not hurt or anything...
rows.notes: Male; Alto's reply shows the line is about him.

rows.en:
Of course not. If I got hurt over something
this small, I'd never cut it in the Pilot Course.

Ahaha...
Ah!? I've gotta hurry!
Crap!
(Alto's sturdier than he looks.)

(Eek, I went to the wrong classroom!
I've gotta hurry!)
Eek!
rows.notes: x16: female player, Claire, Hilda, Shirakawa, Nanase, Sheryl, Akimizu (both genders); a short shriek fits all.

rows.en: Oh, sorry, Saotome-kun.

No, I wasn't watching where I was going either.
Sorry. More importantly, are you okay?
Yeah, I'm totally fine, but...

Well, if I got hurt over something this small,
I'd never cut it in the Pilot Course.
Yeah, that's true.

Ahaha...
Ah!? Oh right, I've gotta hurry!
(Saotome-kun's sturdier than he looks.)

uncertain: c15589/c15592: 'tanoshisa mo aru kedo fuan mo aru n da yo na, kitto' read as the player guessing Alto's feelings ('He's excited, but I bet he's anxious too'); could also be a general remark about everyone.
c15608: object of 'mamoranai to' (the city) restored as 'this place'.
c15629: Alto's 'uwa!' rendered 'Agh!' to avoid two 'Whoa!' in a row (the player's c01769 is 'Whoa!').
